milestones.outcome: A token-free selected-connection snapshot has bounded deterministic policy and private transactional durability, ready for shared runtime wiring.
exit_criteria: Canonical bounded metadata stores no credential or publication authority and enforces one connection per server with stable identity and selected order.
Pure policy rejects stale selection, supports disabled reuse and Forget, and preserves independent profile state.
Real SQLite reopen, transactional rollback, stale writes, cancellation and malformed/newer/refused storage preserve complete data or refuse without authorization.
Profile maintenance inventories and purges the metadata with focused format, architecture and documentation checks.
milestones.boundary: Metadata and policy capability only. Application startup, successful-selection admission and composed restart acceptance remain in the next milestone.

milestones.outcome: The shared profile runtime remembers accepted connections and revalidates the exact selected CLI account across launches without repeating discovery or consent.
exit_criteria: Implement RFC-BPR-0071 AC01–AC04 through shared application startup, exact-host navigation and replacement/sign-out/forget effects.
Persist successful selection promptly, report session-only or disable-save failure, drain admitted saves on Quit, and reject late completions.
Restore pinned host/login/numeric account without inventory or trust prompts; failures remain visible and retry exact authority without private-state exposure.
milestones.boundary: Full runtime integration; composed qualification and final closeout remain.

milestones.outcome: All six RFC criteria have direct composed macOS evidence and the amended contracts and closeout match the final candidate.
exit_criteria: Every RFC-BPR-0071 AC01–AC06 is demonstrated against the RFC baseline through composed macOS fixture courses, including fresh processes and last-window closure.
Tokenless execution, publication consent, global CLI state, storage/refusal and profile maintenance canaries pass; all owning contracts describe implemented scope.
Focused integration and documentation evidence cover the exact final candidate; required acceptance remains explicit.
milestones.boundary: Full authorized RFC and amendment acceptance; no independent or human acceptance is inferred.
